description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/getCategoriesByText. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides the POST get categories by text operation in published product creation and optimization. Use when: Use it when a client needs to run the get categories by text operation for published product creation and optimization. Input: [FromBody] rq: GetCategoriesByTextRequest. Main fields: Text: string. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the categories whose name contains the text. When no category name contains it, returns suggested categories for the text: for eBay and TikTok stores the first one is the HGR suggestion for that text, followed by the marketplace suggestions. Search terms: channellisting getcategoriesbytext. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
